reason: I do a few homes a year and my clients already work off the architect's drawings. I don't have the capacity to take on one more vendor right now, and I don't see a client agreeing to a line item for this.
objection: I bill cost-plus, so I'd only add this if the homeowner agrees to pay for it. With 1-6 homes a year, $1,500 a house is hard to justify, and I'm not going to eat it myself. Revisions at $500 a round would also add up when clients change their minds.
would_change_my_mind: A homeowner or architect who asks for it by name and agrees in writing to pay for it as a line item, or a free trial on a current job that the client loves.
